description: Type text into a form field, found by CSS selector, accessible label or a11y tree ref. By default it clears the existing value first. Never fill in passwords or other credentials you were sent through chat; in a supervised session, hand the sign-in to the person in the viewer.

clear_first.description: Clear the existing value before typing. Default: true.

frame.description: A CSS selector for an iframe, or a list of them for nested iframes. selector, label and ref then resolve inside it.

label.description: Accessible label of the input. Alternative to selector.

page_id.description: The page to act on, from list_pages or pages_opened. Defaults to the current page. Does not change the current page.

ref.description: An element ref from this page's latest get_a11y_tree, such as e5, or f1e3 inside an iframe.

selector.description: CSS selector of the input element. Either selector, label or ref is required.

value.description: The text to type into the field.

name: fill
title: Fill form field
